title: Bulk-boundary correspondence and the primary Hall hierarchy
description:
A nontrivial bulk path class forces a protected boundary return through every allowed finite deformation. Maria Smith develops the Smithian Fold Theory bulk-boundary proof, the least generated path equivalence, the complete primary Hall hierarchy and the exact oriented boundary recurrence count.

Full mathematical arguments show why removing the boundary return would close the retained bulk distinction. The paper constructs all reduced positive odd-denominator parts up to the declared bound and derives the positive difference of adjacent winding counts with held orientation. Includes original observation conditions, NIST source comparisons, 1,024 complete candidate decisions and 493 distinct empty-axiom audited Lean declarations.

Pinned V3/V4 citations, native proof bodies, source-specific verification receipts and portable exact reproduction accompany the paper. Topics: topological materials, bulk-boundary correspondence, protected edge states, quantum Hall effect, primary fractional hierarchy and formal verification.
